name: Windy City Roleplay [Console Support]
desc:
Welcome to Windy City Roleplay, where the city feels alive and your story matters. Dive into a serious roleplay experience built for players who want more than just another game.

Take on roles like police, EMS, civilian, or something a little more... risky. From traffic stops and shootouts to running businesses or hanging with your crew, the city is what you make it.

Features:

Real jobs with full systems (police, EMS, criminal, etc.)

Custom cars, animations, and scenes

A detailed city environment with houses, stores, and more

Serious RP with rules to keep it real

Active community and constant updates

Whether you're out to protect the city or stir up chaos, Windy City Roleplay lets you live out your story — your way.
